name: vision_analyzer
description: Analyze images using Hugging Face vision models with detailed descriptions, visual question answering, and image captioning capabilities.

input_parameters.name: image_path
input_parameters.description: Path to the image file to analyze

input_parameters.name: analysis_prompt
input_parameters.description: Text prompt describing what to analyze in the image
input_parameters.example: What objects can you see in this image and what are they doing?

input_parameters.name: model_name
input_parameters.description: HuggingFace model ID to use for analysis

input_parameters.name: api_token
input_parameters.description: HuggingFace API token (optional, will use config if not provided)

examples.description: Analyze a photo of a city street

input.analysis_prompt: Describe the scene, identify objects, and analyze the mood
Describe what you see in this medical image
